articles.title: New orders & robust demand lift India's October services growth to 4-month high
articles.summary: Growth in India's services sector increased to a four-month high in October due to strong domestic demand and business orders. articles.title: Mint Explainer | What is driving the surge in GST collections from imported goods?
articles.summary: GST revenue from imports rose 42.2% year-on-year to ₹72,246 crore in October, far outpacing domestic growth of about 16%. Higher import values, rupee depreciation and demand for industrial inputs may explain the rise, which boosted overall GST collections and may reflect expanding manufacturing.

articles.title: India targets ₹3 lakh crore defence production by 2029: How far has it come and what is the govt doing?
articles.summary: India's defence production reached ₹1.78 lakh crore in FY2025-26, while exports touched ₹38,424 crore. With the government targeting ₹3 lakh crore in annual production and ₹50,000 crore in exports by 2029, here's a look at the manufacturing progress, key defence initiatives and the road ahead.
